item.title: fix(heartbeat): emit the documented quiet-hours skip event (#124542)
item.summary: fix(heartbeat): emit the documented quiet-hours skip event (#124542) The active-hours guard returned skipped/quiet-hours without emitting a heartbeat event, while every sibling skip in the same stage emits one. 'openclaw system heartbeat last' and the troubleshooting docs promise reason=quiet-hours is observable; the silent return hid the window from operators. Emit the same skipped event the siblings do.
